title: Edit session

meter.plain: Estimate, rest included, as the session runs.
meter.empty: Add exercises to see the duration, rest included.

phaseNote: Your changes apply to the whole cycle. Harder weeks and the deload still adjust sets and effort on top.
placedNote: This session is also in My sessions: changes apply there too.
name: Name

swapNote.pain: Right now {{name}} runs instead, after your pain. That choice still applies.
swapNote.choice: Right now {{name}} runs instead, your choice.

savedProgramme: Session {{letter}} saved. Your changes apply to the whole cycle.
savedProgrammeCardio: Session saved. Your changes apply to the whole cycle.
saveFailed: The session couldn’t be saved. Try again.
resetAllLine_one: Your change to this session applies to every week. Restoring brings back the programme’s version.
resetAllLine_other: Your {{count}} changes to this session apply to every week. Restoring brings back the programme’s version.

resetDialog.title: Restore the programme’s session?
resetDialog.body: The changes are erased from the editor and from every week once you save. Sessions you’ve done stay in your history.

resetDone: Programme’s version back. Save to keep it.
ungroupedToast: The superset is a single exercise again.
circuitToast: Three exercises: it’s now a circuit.
missingBody: This session doesn’t exist any more.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.saveSub: Your changes apply to the whole cycle
leave.saveSubNew: Your session is added to My sessions

act.removeHint: You can put it back until you save
act.removeHintMine: Undo from the message that follows

reorderMode.title: Reorder
reorderMode.hint: Move each block up or down. A group moves as one. To change section, use the block’s actions.

dose.effortHint_one: Stop the set with {{count}} clean rep left.
dose.effortHint_other: Stop the set with {{count}} clean reps left.
dose.effortHint0: Each set until you can’t do another clean rep.
dose.fixedRounds: Rounds: {{n}}, set for the whole group.
dose.noLoad: Load and rep goal follow your history. During the session you can still adjust any set.
dose.noLoadGroup: Rest sits on the group. Load and rep goal follow your history.
dose.rirNote: Jumps and timed holds don’t use an effort target.

group.ungroupLine: Each exercise becomes its own block, {{n}} sets each.

cardio.untouched: Speed and incline follow your programme.
cardio.untouchedMine: Speed and incline stay as they are.

issue.equipment: Not possible with your equipment. Missing: {{equipment}}.
issue.doorwayBar: This move can’t be done on a doorway pull-up bar. Replace it or change your bar.
issue.selectorSwing: Swinging moves aren’t safe with selector dumbbells. Replace it.
issue.groupTooSmall: A group needs at least two exercises.
issue.rangeInvalid: The minimum is above the maximum.
issue.unknownExercise: This exercise is no longer in the catalogue. Replace it.
issue.cardioInGroup: Steady cardio can’t run inside a superset or circuit. Take it out of the group.
issue.emptyMain: Add at least one exercise to the main work.
issue.ropeBeginner: Jump rope takes practice: start with short sets.
issue.noFittingLoad: None of your weights suits this exercise well. Another exercise or more equipment may fit better.
issue.isolationFirst: You open with an isolation move. A compound move first makes better use of your fresh start.
issue.warmupInMain: This is a warm-up drill: it does little as main work.
issue.noWarmup: No warm-up before heavy lifts. A few easy sets help.
issue.aboveLevel: Hard for your level. Keep it if you know it, otherwise pick an easier version.
issue.failureLoaded: Going to failure on a loaded lunge or hinge is risky. Keep at least 1 rep in the tank.
issue.beginnerEffort: At your level, keep at least 2 reps in the tank.
issue.shortRest: Heavy sets need at least a minute of rest.
issue.manySets: {{sets}} sets is a lot for one exercise. More isn’t always better.
issue.sessionVolume: About {{sets}} hard sets in one session is a lot. Recovery may suffer.
issue.muscleVolume: {{muscle}}: {{sets}} sets in one session is a lot.
issue.groupLow: {{group}}: only about {{sets}} hard sets a week. Aim for at least 4.
issue.pushPull: About {{push}} pushing sets to {{pull}} pulling sets a week. Add some pulling to balance.
